text:
aj: Short experiment: launch micro-post that drives people into a 3-step in-app guided tryout. Finish the guide and you unlock a small starter credit + optional webinar seat. Goal = higher first-gen rates, not vanity signups.

elaine: Sounds good. Two CTAs to test? 'Try guided demo' vs 'Reserve webinar seat'.

aj: Yes — split at post-level. Starter credit = 300 tokens.

samir: Routing: tag 'guided-tryout' or 'webinar-reg'. Credit rules: two arms — immediate on signup vs unlocked after first meaningful gen. I'll implement tags and events.

toni: Fraud guard: 1 credit per verified email, domain throttle, require email verification before redemption.

maria: I'll build 3 demo prompts for the guide and a tiny prompt pack for follow-up.

aj: Bench narrative draft: 'median time to first useful output improved 18% with the guided flow in pilot.' Keep claims defensible.

growth-bot: Board created: https://rbw.in/exp/4312349988 (arms: CTA_demo, CTA_webinar, Credit_immediate, Credit_deferred). Added 'public bench copy' column for sign-off.

elainedraft: will share post + email copy today.

aj: Launch target = next Thursday AM PST if no blockers.

samir: I'll drop a webhook spec (email_verified -> allow redemption).

toni: I'll share fraud thresholds.

maria: recording + prompt pack ready for webinar follow-up.

aj: Thanks — owners: aj (owner), elaine (creative), samir (routing), maria (content), toni (fraud).
